title: Stage 2a: align handoff context role parsing with validated evidence health
instructions: PUBLIC Capital Flow QUALITY only; exact base SHA. In handoff.py, _is_context_only currently uses bool(dict(obs.provenance).get('context_only',False)), so string 'false' is incorrectly context-only. Reuse the existing fail-closed _is_context_only(provenance) implementation in evidence_health.py (read-only) rather than inventing divergent parsing; it accepts missing/bool False and case/whitespace-insensitive string 'false' as scoring, bool True/string 'true' as context-only, and unknown/malformed explicit values as context-only. Make minimal handoff.py change only; preserve all existing PIT, normalization, source evidence, family support, scoring formulas, and public output schemas. Add deterministic no-network tests in existing test_v1_handoff.py with real frozen FlowObservation instances, testing missing key, bool values, string ' false ', 'TRUE', malformed 'maybe', and asserting handoff _source_evidence role plus _family_support scoring/context role where practical. Do not mutate frozen dataclasses. Do NOT modify runner.py (its parallel bug is a separate later task), evidence_health.py, or any other files. Only the two allowed write paths. Run targeted pytest and full Capital Flow pytest before commit. No main/private/automation/prediction/API/Telegram/broker/execution/secrets; fail closed; return minimal JSON changed files.
